messages.subject: How to predict?
parts:
Hi

First I import a dataset. Then I run a model. Then I want to run the models on a new observation and get a prediction.

When I try to do that I get an error. What am I doing wrong?

The legends are the same in the file I am trying to predict from but the 2 last columns are unknown so they are blank on the observation row. The RISK_Ajustment and the class decision are unknown. 

When I try to import the file from the evaluation page and run it I get an error.

How shall I do it?

Regards,

Rolf

messages.subject: Re: How to predict?
parts:
Still get errors.

How can I put in the RISK and the target when it is that that is unknown in the new dataset?

And I get errors when I try to use different new data files.

How shall I format the new data? 

Regards,

Rolf

 

Info text:

It seems that the dataset on which the predictions from the rf model are required has some variables missing. This is often the case when your CSV dataset does not have the target variable included (e.g., when your test dataset is meant to be used as a scoring dataset, in which case we can't perform an evaluation). For producing a confusion matrix we need to include the target variable. Please load a CSV file which has the risk and target variables included. 
 The actual error message was:
Error in `[.data.frame`(crs$testset, , c(crs$input, crs$target)) :   undefined columns selected
